name: Contributors record lifecycle facts through the dedicated action
summary: Contributor raw create, update and dependency requests cannot create, convert, change or remove native lifecycle state events, or add, remove, replace or inherit labels for the six fact dimensions, lifecycle-scope, enabled and live. The endpoint checks final effects under the project lock and refuses incomplete reads before native writes, naming lifecycle.py record. Hidden label aliases, attachments and multi-target requests are covered. Ordinary prose, ordinary events and legacy review-ready/reviewed labels stay writable. Listed operator raw writes and dedicated lifecycle/host operations retain their routes. This always-on write boundary leaves legacy lifecycle reads unchanged; it establishes no strict reader provenance or historical repair.
